design: Predict scalar u dot MLP3(x) from a single normalized adjective activation. Frozen output direction and discovery negation span. Aware subspace Q spans N and F*N. Center on discovery16 states; retain exact constant and full linear Taylor term, restrict quadratic to Q.T F Q. Compare rank2/rank8 aware spans, discovery PCA8, random8, linear tangent, and uncentered aware8.
inputs: Predict accepts an independent activation and fixed parameters only; no evaluation quartet factors, labels, teacher outputs or batch-dependent statistics. Labels used for original discovery bases and evaluation grouping only.
interventions: For every directed pair within each quartet, add u*(predicted_scalar(donor)-predicted_scalar(recipient)) to native recipient adjective-position MLP3 write. Compare with exact scalar-output delta, not full MLP replacement or earlier local-only intervention.
limits: Only one frozen output direction, not full layer faithfulness. Exact weight knowledge and supervised discovery used. Development evaluation panel already inspected; a separate prospective panel is still required.
